name: Fed early-Globex ES fixed-window long
mandatory_same_session_close: Sell/flatten at 03:30 Eastern time the same Globex session.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.

source_rules.indicator: Fixed Eastern local clock; no price indicator for OD+.
source_rules.buy: Buy one ES futures position at 01:30 Eastern time on eligible trading dates.
source_rules.sell_short: No short signal in simple OD+ rule.
source_rules.exit: Sell/flatten at 03:30 Eastern time the same Globex session.
source_rules.position_sizing: Source compares one-dollar investment; futures contract sizing and margin budget not specified.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Table IX(b) uses best ask/bid quote spread; brokerage fees, impact and full retail fill uncertainty remain.

source_reported_performance: Table IX(b) simple OD+ annualized mean 1.91% and Sharpe 0.26 after bid/ask, 2004–2020. Shorter OD 02:00–03:00 has net Sharpe −0.54; BtD requires order-flow data and is a different conditional variant.
independent_evidence_note: No independent current-market replication identified; positive net result is small and likely vulnerable to extra costs.
known_risks: Night-time liquidity and macro/European-open shocks; no stop; daylight-saving sensitivity; margin/roll and spread.
data_requirements: Dated ES bid/ask or tick/M1 quotes around 01:30 and 03:30 ET, Globex calendar, holiday/DST and roll metadata.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: Trade only if the dated contract has an uninterrupted 01:30–03:30 session; one position maximum; fixed contract size and any stop are new, untested rules.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Institutional paper; small positive after-spread result
special_case: This clock window is early morning but starts and ends within one Globex session; do not carry through maintenance break.
